name: CloudBees Unify MCP
description: Checks builds, triggers workflows, triages security findings, and manages feature flags in CloudBees Unify from AI coding clients, for DevOps and platform teams.

skills.name: Component Management
skills.description: Creates, lists, searches, and deletes CloudBees Unify components so agents can organize services without the dashboard.

skills.name: Workflow Operations
skills.description: Lists, validates, updates, and triggers CloudBees Unify workflows, and checks the status and logs of recent builds.

skills.name: Security Findings
skills.description: Investigates security findings, issues, and reports from CloudBees Unify to summarize the vulnerabilities found in a build.

skills.name: CI Controller Insights
skills.description: Lists connected CI controllers and retrieves their reports so engineers can inspect CI health from their IDE.

skills.name: Feature Flag Configuration
skills.description: Manages feature flag configurations, such as enabling a flag for a staging environment, within the user's RBAC roles.
